name: How long does a typical bathroom cabinet installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom cabinet installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom cabinet installation can vary depending on the complexity of the project, the number of cabinets, and whether any demolition or structural modifications are required. A straightforward replacement of existing cabinets might take a day or less, while a complete custom installation involving multiple units or significant alterations could extend to several days. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial consultation and assessment, ensuring you know what to expect. Factors like existing plumbing or electrical layouts can influence the timeline, requiring careful planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from less than a day for simple replacements to several days for complex or custom projects, depending on scope and modifications.
